keys.interrupt: Leave the Hub; twice: leave without asking
keys.suspend: Suspend to the shell (fg to come back)
keys.focus: Move between controls: the sidebar, then the top bar, then the page
keys.region: Jump to the next or previous area (sidebar, top bar, page)
keys.conflict.ctrlM: Ctrl+M, Ctrl+I, Ctrl+[ arrive as Enter, Tab, Esc: run those page keys from the palette (Ctrl+K)
keys.conflict.flow: Ctrl+S / Ctrl+Q may be held by the terminal's flow control: use the palette
nav.title: Pages
status.demo: Demo · sample data, nothing is changed
status.keys: Tab move · Enter open · Ctrl+K commands · ? keys · q quit
status.keysTyping: Typing · Esc leaves the field · Ctrl+K commands
status.noSearch: This page has no search field
small.title: Terminal too small
small.size: This terminal is {{cols}}×{{rows}}; the Hub needs at least {{minCols}}×{{minRows}}.
small.leave: Make the window larger to go on, or press q to leave.
small.leaveLocked: Make the window larger to go on, or press Ctrl+C to leave.
error.title: This page could not be drawn.
leave.keys: y leave · n or Esc stay
leave.body_one: {{count}} upload or change is still running from this Hub. If you leave, it stops, and it may have gone through. Check it again afterwards.
leave.body_other: {{count}} uploads or changes are still running from this Hub. If you leave, they stop, and each may have gone through. Check them again afterwards.
status.againForced: Press Ctrl+C again to leave without asking
palette.hint: ↑↓ choose · Enter run · Esc close · Ctrl+K anytime
dock.failed: Agent could not load here. Alt+J closes this.
dock.name: Agent
lock.store.why.failed: A write to it failed, so nothing more is saved there.
lock.store.why.forgetFailed: Too many wrong passcodes were entered, and this account's Hub data could not be removed.
lock.store.why.unsafe: Its directory, or one above it, can be changed by someone else or is not a plain directory.
lock.store.why.corrupt: Its files do not read back as they were written.
lock.store.place.unknown: the Hub's data directory for this account (under the hoody data directory)
lock.store.problem: The Hub is locked because its saved data cannot be used. {{why}}
lock.store.repair: Close the Hub, then repair {{place}} or move it aside (rename it) and start the Hub again. "Forget this terminal's Hub data" cannot work while the data cannot be used.
lock.store.forgetRepair: The passcode will not open it. Close the Hub, move {{place}} aside (rename it), then start the Hub again: it starts without a passcode and without the changes that were still open, so check those in the web Hub.
lock.store.agentKeys: If you move it aside, keys this terminal made for agents (named "hoody-agent auto term …") stay valid until they expire; you can remove them in the web Hub.
lock.refused.otherHub: Another Hub is open for this account. Unlock in the Hub that is already open.
lock.refused.readOnlyChoice: This Hub was started read-only, so it cannot count passcode tries. Start it without read-only to unlock.
lock.refused.noStore: The Hub's saved data cannot be used, so the passcode cannot be checked here.
filepick.helpOne: A terminal has no file picker: type the path of a file on this machine.
filepick.helpMany: A terminal has no file picker: type the path of each file on this machine, one per line.
filepick.none: Type the path of a file first.
filepick.onlyOne: Only one file can be chosen here.
filepick.folder: {{path}} is a folder: choose the files in it, one per line.
filepick.tooBig: {{path}} is larger than {{max}}, the most one file can be.
live.secretScreen.title: Not sent: this screen can't show secrets
live.secretScreen.body: A key, a code or another secret shown here could stay on the screen after you leave, so nothing that would show one is sent. Run the Hub full screen in a terminal window (output not piped, TERM set), then try again.
